name: BanLog
author: Kirin
short: Keeps the messages Discord purges when a member is banned
description: Stores a rolling 7-day copy of Unicornia's messages and snapshots a banned member's messages into a permanent ban record that staff can read on staff.unicornia.net.
install_msg: Thanks for installing BanLog. The bot needs View Audit Log in Unicornia, or bans are not recorded.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores a copy of every non-bot message posted in Unicornia (content, latest edit, attachment filenames, and deletion time) for 7 days. When a member is banned, their messages from that week are copied into a permanent ban record with the moderator and reason. Red data-deletion requests remove the user's stored messages; stricter requests also remove their ban records and replace them as moderator with a placeholder.
